## Our aim

Power Systems Foundation is an open learning resource for students, researchers, and practising engineers. Its goal is to make important power-system concepts rigorous without making them needlessly difficult to approach.

A strong tutorial should connect four layers:

1. the physical phenomenon;
2. the modelling assumptions;
3. the mathematical formulation; and
4. the computational or engineering application.

## Topics

The collection welcomes tutorials covering areas such as:

- power-flow analysis and network modelling;
- state estimation and measurement systems;
- optimisation and electricity markets;
- dynamics, stability, and control;
- protection and power-system operation;
- renewable generation and inverter-based resources; and
- reproducible power-system software.

## Contributing

This project is developed publicly on GitHub. Corrections, questions, worked examples, and new tutorials are welcome. Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Plusero/powersys-foundation/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) before opening a pull request.
